investigation evidence never lands on `/var/gerrit`, + add the missing `/var/gerrit`

This ticket now carries no active acute work; its remaining AC (durable growth/headroom) is
delegated to the trackers above. Recommend it can be closed once an operator confirms the
delegation is sufficient — left open at P3 pending that call.
